title: Transport va chipta olish
goal_uz: Dars oxirida transport turlarini nomlaysiz, by bus va on foot qoliplarini to‘g‘ri ishlatasiz, kassada borib-qaytish yoki bir tomonlama chipta so‘raysiz hamda jo‘nash vaqti, perron, narx va yo‘l qancha vaqt olishini so‘raysiz.

scenes.title: Transport va chipta
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Yigirma uchinchi darsga xush kelibsiz. O‘tgan darsda joy predloglarini o‘rgandik: in, on, at, next to, between. Bugun ulardan hayotda foydalanamiz: shaharda transport tanlaymiz va vokzalda chipta sotib olamiz. Dars oxirida ingliz tilida chipta so‘rab, jo‘nash vaqtini, perronni va yo‘l qancha vaqt olishini so‘ray olasiz.
scenes.say: Hello again! Today we talk about transport and buy a ticket.
scenes.say_uz: Yana salom! Bugun transport haqida gaplashamiz va chipta sotib olamiz.

scenes.title: Asosiy transport turlari
scenes.say_native: Boshlaymiz. Eng kerakli so‘zlar: bus — avtobus, train — poyezd, taxi — taksi, car — yengil mashina, bike yoki bicycle — velosiped, plane — samolyot. Bu so‘zlarni oldin artikl bilan o‘rganing: a bus, a train, a taxi. Har bir transportning o‘z nomi bor, ularni aralashtirmang.
scenes.say: Bus, train, taxi, car, bike, plane.
scenes.say_uz: Avtobus, poyezd, taksi, mashina, velosiped, samolyot.

scenes.title: Yana transport va joylar

examples.t: The bus stop is near the station.

scenes.say_native: Yana bir nechta so‘z. Tram — tramvay, coach — shaharlararo uzoq masofaga qatnaydigan avtobus, ferry — daryo yoki dengizdan o‘tadigan kema. Londonda metro “the Underground” yoki “the Tube” deyiladi. Amerikada esa “subway”. Joylar: station — bekat yoki vokzal, bus stop — avtobus bekati, airport — aeroport. Bu so‘zlar chipta olishda doim kerak bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: Tram, coach, ferry, Tube. Station, bus stop, airport.
scenes.say_uz: Tramvay, shaharlararo avtobus, kema, metro. Vokzal, avtobus bekati, aeroport.

scenes.title: Bu nima?
board: 3) It has two wheels. You pedal.
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Men tavsif aytaman, siz transportni toping. Birinchisi: u uchadi. Ikkinchisi: u relslarda yuradi. Uchinchisi: uning ikkita g‘ildiragi bor va uni pedal bilan haydaysiz. Har bir javobni ingliz tilida, artikl bilan ayting. Shoshilmang, har bir so‘zni aniq talaffuz qiling.
scenes.say: One. It flies. Two. It runs on rails. Three. It has two wheels, and you pedal.
scenes.say_uz: Bir. U uchadi. Ikki. U relslarda yuradi. Uch. Uning ikkita g‘ildiragi bor va siz pedal bosasiz.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchisi — a plane, samolyot. Ikkinchisi — a train, poyezd. Tramvay ham relsda yuradi, lekin u shahar ichida qatnaydi. Uchinchisi — a bike yoki a bicycle. Ingliz tilida kundalik gapda “bike” ko‘p aytiladi, “bicycle” esa rasmiyroq. Hammasini topgan bo‘lsangiz, barakalla!
scenes.say: A plane. A train. A bike.
scenes.say_uz: Samolyot. Poyezd. Velosiped.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: urg‘uli so‘zlar
scenes.say_native: Talaffuzga e’tibor bering. Station — urg‘u birinchi bo‘g‘inda: STAY-shn, oxirida “o” ni aniq aytmaymiz. Taxi — TAK-si. Airport — AIR-port, urg‘u “air” da. Bicycle — BY-si-kl, ichida “ik” yengil. O‘zbek tilida urg‘u ko‘pincha oxirgi bo‘g‘inda bo‘ladi, ingliz tilida esa bu so‘zlarda boshida. Shuni yodda tutsangiz, gapingiz tabiiy chiqadi.
scenes.say: Station. Taxi. Airport. Bicycle.
scenes.say_uz: Vokzal. Taksi. Aeroport. Velosiped.

scenes.title: By + transport
board: by bus, by train, by car, by plane
by bike, by taxi, by boat

examples.t: I go to work by bus.
He goes to school by bike.

scenes.say_native: Endi asosiy qoida. Biror joyga qanday yetib borishni aytish uchun “by” predlogidan keyin transport nomini qo‘yamiz va artiklsiz: by bus, by train, by car. Ya’ni “by the bus” demaymiz. Bu o‘zbekchadagi “avtobusda”, “poyezdda”, “mashinada” ma’nosiga to‘g‘ri keladi. Savol: qanday? Javob: by bus.
scenes.say: I go to work by bus.
scenes.say_uz: Men ishga avtobusda boraman.

scenes.title: Fe’l bilan: go, travel, come

examples.t: She goes to London by train.
I take the bus every day.

scenes.say_native: “By” bilan odatda harakat fe’llari ishlatiladi: go — bormoq, come — kelmoq, travel — sayohat qilmoq. Esingizda bo‘lsin, he, she, it bilan fe’lga s qo‘shiladi: she goes, he comes. Siz bu qoidani oldingi darslarda o‘rgangansiz. Yana bir mashhur variant: take the bus — avtobusga o‘tirib bormoq. Bunda artikl bor, chunki aniq avtobus nazarda tutiladi.
scenes.say: She goes to the city by train. I take the bus.
scenes.say_uz: U shaharga poyezdda boradi. Men avtobusga o‘tiraman.

scenes.title: On foot — piyoda
board: = I go to school on foot.
scenes.say_native: Piyoda yurish uchun alohida ibora bor: on foot. Bu yerda “by” emas, “on” ishlatiladi va artikl yo‘q. Yana oddiy yo‘l: walk fe’li. “I walk to school” va “I go to school on foot” bir xil ma’noni beradi. Birinchisi qisqaroq va tabiiyroq, shuning uchun ingliz tilida ko‘proq aytiladi. Ikkalasini ham bilib oling.
scenes.say: I walk to school. Or: I go to school on foot.
scenes.say_uz: Men maktabga piyoda boraman. Yoki: maktabga piyoda boraman.

scenes.title: Typik xatolar
scenes.say_native: O‘zbek tilida so‘zlovchilar uchta xato qiladi. Birinchisi: artikl qo‘yish, “by the bus”. To‘g‘ri: “by bus”. Ikkinchisi: “by foot”, chunki “piyoda”ni “by” bilan bog‘lash oson. To‘g‘risi: “on foot”. Uchinchisi: “avtobus bilan” deb “with bus” deyish. Ingliz tilida “with” emas, “by” kerak. Bu xatolarni bir marta eslab qolsangiz, boshqa qilmaysiz.
scenes.say: Say: by bus. On foot. Not: by the bus, by foot.
scenes.say_uz: Ayting: by bus. On foot. Quyidagicha emas: by the bus, by foot.

scenes.title: To‘g‘ri variantni tanlang
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Bo‘sh joyga to‘g‘ri so‘zni qo‘ying. Birinchi gap: men ishga poyezdda boraman. Ikkinchi gap: u piyoda boradi. Uchinchi gap: biz Parijga samolyotda boramiz. Baland ovozda to‘liq gapni ayting. Javobni ichingizda emas, baland ovozda ayting, shunda xotirada yaxshi qoladi.
scenes.say: One. I go to work blank train. Two. She goes blank foot. Three. We go to Paris blank plane.
scenes.say_uz: Bir. Men ishga bo‘sh joy poyezdda boraman. Ikki. U bo‘sh joy piyoda boradi. Uch. Biz Parijga bo‘sh joy samolyotda boramiz.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) I go to work by train.
3) We go to Paris by plane.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi — by train. Ikkinchi — on foot. Uchinchi — by plane. E’tibor bering: faqat “piyoda” ma’nosida “on” ishlatiladi, qolgan hammasida “by”. Agar bularning hammasini to‘g‘ri aytgan bo‘lsangiz, bugungi dars asosiy qismini egallab bo‘ldingiz.
scenes.say: By train. On foot. By plane.
scenes.say_uz: Poyezdda. Piyoda. Samolyotda.

scenes.title: By bus va on the bus
board: in the car / in a taxi
scenes.say_native: Yana bir muhim farq. “By bus” — qanday borishingizni aytadi. “On the bus” esa aniq avtobusning ichida ekaningizni bildiradi: “I’m on the bus”, ya’ni men hozir avtobusdaman. Mashina va taksida “in” ishlatiladi: in the car, in a taxi. Telefonda ko‘p eshitasiz: “I’m on the train” — men poyezddaman. Ikkala shaklning vazifasi boshqa-boshqa.
scenes.say: I go to work by bus. Now I am on the bus.
scenes.say_uz: Men ishga avtobusda boraman. Hozir avtobusdaman.

scenes.title: Qanday borasiz? Savol va javob
board: How do you get to work?
How does she get to school?

examples.t: How do you get to school?
How does he get to work? By car.

scenes.say_native: Transport haqida so‘rash uchun “How do you get to work?” savolini ishlating, ya’ni ishga qanday yetib borasiz? Get to — yetib bormoq. Javob qisqa bo‘lishi mumkin: “By bus” yoki “On foot”. Uchinchi shaxsda do o‘rniga does keladi: How does she get to school? Fe’lga s qo‘shilmaydi, chunki does ishning hammasini bajaradi.
scenes.say: How do you get to work? By bus.
scenes.say_uz: Ishga qanday borasiz? Avtobusda.

scenes.title: O‘zingiz haqingizda
board: How do you get to work or school?
scenes.say_native: Endi o‘zingiz haqingizda gapiring. Ishga yoki o‘qishga qanday borasiz? Uchta gap tuzing. Masalan: bir kun avtobusda, bir kun piyoda, dam olish kuni mashinada. “I go by” va “I walk” iboralaridan foydalaning. Xato qilishdan qo‘rqmang, xatolar o‘rganishning bir qismi.
scenes.say: How do you get to work or school? Say three sentences.
scenes.say_uz: Ishga yoki o‘qishga qanday borasiz? Uchta gap ayting.

scenes.title: Namuna javob
board: I go to work by bus.
On Saturday I go by car.
scenes.say_native: Namuna javob mana bunday: I go to work by bus. On Saturday I go by car. Sometimes I walk. Sizning javobingiz boshqacha bo‘lishi mumkin, muhimi — “by” dan keyin artikl yo‘qligi va piyoda yurish uchun “on foot” yoki “walk”. Yana bir foydali so‘z: sometimes — ba’zan, u odatda fe’ldan oldin keladi.
scenes.say: I go to work by bus. Sometimes I walk.
scenes.say_uz: Men ishga avtobusda boraman. Ba’zan piyoda boraman.

scenes.title: Vokzalda: kerakli so‘zlar

examples.t: The timetable is on the wall.

scenes.say_native: Endi vokzalga o‘tamiz. Ticket — chipta. Ticket office — chipta kassasi. Ticket machine — chipta avtomati. Timetable — poyezdlar jadvali, platform — perron, ya’ni poyezd to‘xtaydigan joy. Predloglar eslaysizmi? “The ticket office is next to the café”, “The train is at platform four”. Bu so‘zlar sizga o‘tgan darsdagi predloglar bilan birga kerak bo‘ladi.
scenes.say: Ticket office. Timetable. Platform.
scenes.say_uz: Chipta kassasi. Jadval. Perron.

scenes.title: Chipta so‘rash
board: Can I have a ticket to Leeds, please?
I'd like a ticket to Leeds, please.

examples.t: Can I have a ticket to York, please?
I'd like a ticket to Bath, please.

scenes.say_native: Chipta so‘rashning uchta usuli bor. Eng oson: “A ticket to Leeds, please”. Undan yaxshiroq: “Can I have a ticket to Leeds, please?” — chipta olsam bo‘ladimi? Yana muloyim ibora: “I’d like a ticket to Leeds, please”. Har qanday holatda oxirida “please” deyish kerak. Ingliz tilida muloyimlik juda qadrlanadi, hatto kassirga ham.
scenes.say: Can I have a ticket to Leeds, please?
scenes.say_uz: Leedsga chipta olsam bo‘ladimi?

scenes.title: Single va return
scenes.say_native: Ikkita muhim so‘z. Single — faqat bir tomonga, borish uchun. Return — borish va qaytish. Kassir deydi: “Single or return?” Britaniyada shunday. Amerikada esa one-way va round-trip. Bu so‘zlar sizga faqat transportda emas, samolyot chiptasida ham kerak bo‘ladi. Narx ko‘pincha farq qiladi, shuning uchun kassirdan so‘rang.
scenes.say: A single to Leeds, please. Or a return?
scenes.say_uz: Leedsga bir tomonlama, iltimos. Yoki borib-qaytishmi?

scenes.title: Chipta so‘rashda xatolar
board: ✓ Can I have a ticket to Leeds, please?
✗ a ticket in Leeds → ✓ a ticket to Leeds
scenes.say_native: Xatolarga qarang. Birinchi xato: “Give me ticket Leeds”. Bu qo‘pol eshitiladi, artikl ham tushib qolgan, “to” ham yo‘q. To‘g‘risi: “Can I have a ticket to Leeds, please?” Ikkinchi xato: “in Leeds” deyish, chunki o‘zbekchada “Leedsga” deymiz. Yo‘nalish uchun “to” kerak: a ticket to Leeds. Bu xatolar odatda tezlikda chiqadi, shuning uchun sekin gapiring.
scenes.say: Can I have a ticket to Leeds, please? Not: Give me ticket Leeds.
scenes.say_uz: Leedsga chipta olsam bo‘ladimi? Quyidagicha emas: Give me ticket Leeds.

scenes.title: Chipta so‘rang
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Kassada turibsiz. Birinchi: Londonga borib-qaytish chiptasi. Ikkinchi: Bathga bir tomonlama chipta. Uchinchi: Cardiffga ikkita borib-qaytish chiptasi. “Can I have” bilan to‘liq gap tuzing. Oxirida please ni unutmang. Agar qiyin bo‘lsa, pauza tugmasini bosib, qayta urinib ko‘ring.
scenes.say: One. London, return. Two. Bath, single. Three. Cardiff, two returns.
scenes.say_uz: Bir. London, borib-qaytish. Ikki. Bath, bir tomonlama. Uch. Cardiff, ikkita borib-qaytish.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) Can I have a return to London, please?
2) Can I have a single to Bath, please?
3) Can I have two returns to Cardiff, please?
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchisi: Can I have a return to London, please? Ikkinchisi: Can I have a single to Bath, please? Uchinchisi: Can I have two returns to Cardiff, please? Ikkita bo‘lsa, return so‘ziga s qo‘shiladi: two returns. Chipta so‘zi ko‘pincha aytilmaydi, “a return to London” ham to‘liq to‘g‘ri.
scenes.say: A return to London. A single to Bath. Two returns to Cardiff.
scenes.say_uz: Londonga borib-qaytish. Bathga bir tomonlama. Cardiffga ikkita borib-qaytish.

scenes.title: Jo‘nash vaqti
board: What time does the train leave?

examples.t: What time does the bus leave?

examples.uz: U o‘n birda o‘ttizda yetib keladi.

scenes.say_native: Endi vaqtni so‘raymiz. “What time does the train leave?” — poyezd soat nechada jo‘naydi? Javob: “It leaves at ten fifteen”. Arrive — yetib kelmoq: “What time does it arrive?” Gapda does bor, shuning uchun asosiy fe’l o‘zgarmaydi: does leave, does arrive. Fe’lga s yozish xatosi bu yerda juda ko‘p uchraydi. O‘zbekchada bunday qoida yo‘q, shu sababli ehtiyot bo‘ling.
scenes.say: What time does the train leave? It leaves at ten fifteen.
scenes.say_uz: Poyezd soat nechada jo‘naydi? U o‘n o‘n beshda jo‘naydi.

scenes.title: Perron
scenes.say_native: Perron haqida: “Which platform?” — qaysi perron? Javob: “Platform three”. Ikkita foydali shakl bor. Poyezd perrondan jo‘naydi: “It leaves from platform three”. Poyezd hozir perronda turibdi: “The train is on platform three”. Ya’ni jo‘nash haqida gapirsak, from; turgan joyi haqida on. Raqamni oddiy son bilan aytasiz: platform one, platform two.
scenes.say: Which platform? It leaves from platform three.
scenes.say_uz: Qaysi perron? U uchinchi perrondan jo‘naydi.

scenes.title: Jadvalni o‘qing
board: Q1: What time is the Bristol train?  Q2: Which platform for Leeds?
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Jadvalga qarang: London — to‘qqiz o‘ttiz, ikkinchi perron. Bristol — o‘n besh daqiqa o‘tgan, oltinchi perron. Leeds — o‘n bir yigirma, to‘qqizinchi perron. Ikkita savolga javob bering. Birinchi: Bristol poyezdi soat nechada? Ikkinchi: Leedsga qaysi perron?
scenes.say: What time does the Bristol train leave? Which platform for Leeds?
scenes.say_uz: Bristol poyezdi soat nechada jo‘naydi? Leedsga qaysi perron?

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Bristol poyezdi — soat o‘n nol besh, ya’ni “ten oh five”. Leedsga — to‘qqizinchi perron: “Platform nine”. Ingliz tilida 10:05 ni “ten oh five” deyiladi, nol harfi “oh” deb aytiladi. Bu juda ko‘p uchraydigan odat. To‘g‘ri aytgan bo‘lsangiz, vaqtni o‘qiy olasiz.
scenes.say: Ten oh five. Platform nine.
scenes.say_uz: O‘n nol besh. To‘qqizinchi perron.

scenes.title: Narx va to‘lov
board: Can I pay by card? Cash or card?

examples.t: How much is a single to Leeds?

scenes.say_native: Narxni so‘rash uchun: “How much is it?” Javob: “It’s twenty-four pounds fifty”, ya’ni yigirma to‘rt funt ellik pens. Pounds dan keyin pens so‘zi odatda aytilmaydi. To‘lovda yana “by” ishlatiladi: “Can I pay by card?” Kassir so‘raydi: “Cash or card?” Ko‘ryapsizmi, “by” transportda ham, to‘lov usulida ham vosita bildiradi.
scenes.say: How much is it? Can I pay by card?
scenes.say_uz: Bu qancha turadi? Karta bilan to‘lasam bo‘ladimi?

scenes.title: Narxni ayting
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Narxlarni ingliz tilida ayting. Birinchisi: besh funt yigirma pens. Ikkinchisi: o‘n ikki funt yetmish besh. Uchinchisi: qirq sakkiz funt. Uchinchisida pens yo‘q, shuning uchun faqat “pounds” deysiz. Baland ovozda ayting. Javobingizni kutaman, tayyor bo‘lgach davom etamiz.
scenes.say: Five pounds twenty. Twelve pounds seventy-five. Forty-eight pounds.
scenes.say_uz: Besh funt yigirma. O‘n ikki funt yetmish besh. Qirq sakkiz funt.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar: five pounds twenty, twelve pounds seventy-five, forty-eight pounds. Funtdan keyin raqam bo‘lsa, ko‘pincha pens so‘zisiz aytiladi: five twenty ham tushuniladi. Yana narx bir funt bo‘lsa, “one pound” deymiz, s qo‘shilmaydi. Narxni to‘g‘ri eshitib tushunish chipta olishda juda muhim.
scenes.say: Five twenty. Twelve seventy-five. Forty-eight pounds.
scenes.say_uz: Besh yigirma. O‘n ikki yetmish besh. Qirq sakkiz funt.

scenes.title: Dialog: kassada
board: Clerk: Good morning. Can I help you?
Anna: A return to Oxford, please.
Clerk: £22.50. Anna: Can I pay by card?
scenes.say_native: Endi birinchi dialogni tinglang. Anna Oksfordga ketmoqchi. U kassada borib-qaytish chiptasi so‘raydi, narxni bilib oladi va karta bilan to‘lashga ruxsat so‘raydi. Oxirida kassir jo‘nash vaqti va perronni aytadi. Diqqat bilan eshiting, keyin savollarga javob berasiz.
scenes.say: Good morning. Can I help you? A return to Oxford, please. That's twenty-two pounds fifty. Can I pay by card? Of course. The next train leaves at ten forty, from platform three.
scenes.say_uz: Xayrli tong. Yordam bera olamanmi? Oksfordga borib-qaytish chiptasi, iltimos. Yigirma ikki funt ellik pens. Karta bilan to‘lasam bo‘ladimi? Albatta. Keyingi poyezd o‘n qirqda, uchinchi perrondan jo‘naydi.

scenes.title: Tushunganingizni tekshiring
scenes.say_native: Savollar. Birinchi: Anna qanday chipta oldi — single yoki return? Ikkinchi: chipta qancha turadi? Uchinchi: poyezd soat nechada va qaysi perrondan jo‘naydi? Qisqa, to‘liq javob bering. Kerak bo‘lsa, dialogni yana bir marta eslang. Buni o‘zingizning ovozingiz bilan aytish eng samarali usul.
scenes.say: One. Single or return? Two. How much is the ticket? Three. What time, and which platform?
scenes.say_uz: Bir. Bir tomonlama yoki borib-qaytish? Ikki. Chipta qancha turadi? Uch. Soat nechada va qaysi perrondan?

scenes.title: Dialog javoblari
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi — return, ya’ni borib-qaytish. Ikkinchi — twenty-two pounds fifty. Uchinchi — soat o‘n qirq, ten forty, uchinchi perron. Anna ham kassirga “please” va “can I” bilan murojaat qildi, bu dars boshidagi muloyim shakl. Siz ham xuddi shunday gapirasiz.
scenes.say: A return. Twenty-two fifty. Ten forty, platform three.
scenes.say_uz: Borib-qaytish. Yigirma ikki ellik. O‘n qirq, uchinchi perron.

scenes.title: Yo‘l qancha vaqt oladi?
scenes.say_native: Eng muhim savol: “How long does it take?” Bu yo‘l qancha vaqt oladi, ya’ni necha soat ketadi? Javob: “It takes two hours”. O‘zbekchada “ikki soat ketadi” deymiz, inglizcha esa fe’l take, ya’ni “oladi”. Shu moslikni eslab qolsangiz bo‘ldi. Does bilan so‘zlaganda take s siz, javobda esa takes bo‘ladi, chunki “it” uchinchi shaxs.
scenes.say: How long does it take? It takes two hours.
scenes.say_uz: Bu qancha vaqt oladi? Ikki soat oladi.

scenes.title: Transport bilan qo‘shib
board: It takes about an hour by train.
How long does the journey take?

examples.t: It takes ten minutes on foot.
How long does the journey take?

scenes.say_native: Endi transportni qo‘shamiz. “It takes twenty minutes by bus”, “It takes about an hour by train”. About — taxminan, aniq vaqtni bilmasangiz ishlatiladi. Savolni to‘liqroq berish mumkin: “How long does the journey take?” Journey — safar, yo‘l. Journey — bir joydan ikkinchi joyga borish jarayoni.
scenes.say: It takes about an hour by train.
scenes.say_uz: Poyezdda taxminan bir soat oladi.

scenes.title: Vaqt so‘rashdagi xatolar
board: ✗ It takes two hours → does it takes
scenes.say_native: Mana xatolar. Birinchi: “How long it takes?” — does tushib qolgan. To‘g‘risi: “How long does it take?” Ikkinchi: “How long does it takes”, ya’ni does bor bo‘lsa-da, fe’lga s qo‘shish. Uchinchisi: o‘zbekchadan so‘zma-so‘z “How much time you need?” — bu tushuniladi, ammo noto‘g‘ri eshitiladi. “It takes” iborasini tayyor qolip kabi yodlab oling.
scenes.say: How long does it take? It takes one hour.
scenes.say_uz: Bu qancha vaqt oladi? Bir soat oladi.

scenes.title: Jadvaldan foydalaning
board: Q: How long does it take by train? by bus?
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Shaharga borishning uch yo‘li bor. Mashinada bir soat. Poyezdda qirq daqiqa. Avtobusda bir soat o‘ttiz daqiqa. Savol: poyezdda qancha vaqt oladi? Avtobusda-chi? Ikkala javobni “It takes” bilan to‘liq ayting. Avval qoidani eslang, keyin gapni tuzing.
scenes.say: How long does it take by train? And by bus?
scenes.say_uz: Poyezdda qancha vaqt oladi? Avtobusda-chi?

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: By train: It takes forty minutes.
By bus: It takes an hour and a half.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Poyezdda — it takes forty minutes. Avtobusda — it takes an hour and a half, ya’ni bir yarim soat. “One hour thirty minutes” ham to‘g‘ri, lekin “an hour and a half” tabiiyroq eshitiladi. Eng tez variant — poyezd. Ko‘rdingizmi, nima uchun odamlar “by train” ni tanlaydi?
scenes.say: It takes forty minutes by train. It takes an hour and a half by bus.
scenes.say_uz: Poyezdda qirq daqiqa oladi. Avtobusda bir yarim soat oladi.

scenes.title: Dialog: aeroportga qanday boramiz?
board: Ben: Excuse me, how do I get to the airport?
Mrs Clark: You can take the train or the bus.
Ben: How long does it take by train?
Mrs Clark: Thirty minutes. The bus takes forty-five.
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog. Sayyoh Ben bekatda notanish ayoldan aeroportga qanday borishni so‘raydi. Ayol uni ikki yo‘l bilan tanishtiradi. Ben vaqt va narxni so‘raydi, keyin tanlaydi. E’tibor bering: “Excuse me” so‘zlari bilan muloyim murojaat qilinadi. Tinglang va keyin savollarga javob bering.
scenes.say: Excuse me, how do I get to the airport? You can take the train or the bus. How long does it take by train? Thirty minutes. The bus takes forty-five. How much is the train? Eight pounds. The train, then. Thank you.
scenes.say_uz: Kechirasiz, aeroportga qanday boraman? Poyezdga yoki avtobusga o‘tirishingiz mumkin. Poyezdda qancha vaqt oladi? O‘ttiz daqiqa. Avtobus qirq besh daqiqa oladi. Poyezd qancha turadi? Sakkiz funt. Unda poyezd. Rahmat.

scenes.title: Tinglab tushunish
board: 3) How much is the train?  4) What does Ben choose?
scenes.say_native: Savollar. Birinchi: poyezdda aeroportgacha qancha vaqt ketadi? Ikkinchi: avtobusda-chi? Uchinchi: poyezd chiptasi qancha? To‘rtinchi: Ben nimani tanladi? Qisqa javoblar bering, masalan “thirty minutes”. To‘liq gap bilan javob berishga harakat qiling.
scenes.say: One. How long by train? Two. How long by bus? Three. How much is the train? Four. What does Ben choose?
scenes.say_uz: Bir. Poyezdda qancha? Ikki. Avtobusda qancha? Uch. Poyezd qancha turadi? To‘rt. Ben nimani tanladi?

scenes.title: Dialog javoblari
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Poyezdda — o‘ttiz daqiqa. Avtobusda — qirq besh daqiqa. Poyezd chiptasi — sakkiz funt. Ben poyezdni tanladi. Dialogdagi “The train, then” — “unda poyezd”. “Then” so‘zi qaror qabul qilganda ishlatiladi. Bu qisqa ibora tabiiy suhbatda juda foydali, uni eslab qoling.
scenes.say: Thirty minutes. Forty-five minutes. Eight pounds. The train.
scenes.say_uz: O‘ttiz daqiqa. Qirq besh daqiqa. Sakkiz funt. Poyezd.

scenes.title: Tez gapirganda: kuchsiz shakllar
board: a single to London → /ə ˈsɪŋɡl tə ˈlʌndən/
scenes.say_native: Tabiiy nutq haqida. Tez gapirganda “a” va “to” kuchsiz aytiladi, ular shunchaki “ə” kabi qisqa tovushga aylanadi: a single to London. Bu yerda “to” deyarli “tə”. “Can I have” so‘zlari bir-biriga qo‘shilib eshitiladi: “kənai hav”. “What time does it leave” esa sekin aytsangiz ham bo‘ladi, lekin so‘zlar orasiga to‘xtash qo‘ymang. Eshitganingizni takrorlang.
scenes.say: A single to London. Can I have a return? What time does it leave?
scenes.say_uz: Londonga bir tomonlama chipta. Borib-qaytish chiptasi olsam bo‘ladimi? U soat nechada jo‘naydi?

scenes.title: Ritm bilan takrorlang
scenes.say_native: Takrorlang. Muhim so‘zlarni — single, London, return, leave — kuchliroq, qolganlarini yengil ayting. Ritm shunday: a SINgle to LONdon, please. Can I have a reTURN? What TIME does it LEAVE? Kamida ikki marta takrorlang, tezlikni asta oshiring. Diqqat bilan va xotirjam bajaring, vaqt yetarli.
scenes.say: A single to London, please. Can I have a return? What time does it leave?
scenes.say_uz: Londonga bir tomonlama chipta, iltimos. Borib-qaytish chiptasi olsam bo‘ladimi? U soat nechada jo‘naydi?

scenes.title: Britaniya va Amerika
board: UK: timetable, the Tube  |  US: schedule, subway
scenes.say_native: Britaniya va Amerika varianti farq qiladi. Britaniyada single va return, Amerikada one-way va round-trip. Jadval Britaniyada timetable, Amerikada schedule. Metro Londonda Tube yoki Underground, Amerikada subway. Qaysi shaklni ishlatish sizga bog‘liq, lekin Angliyaga borsangiz, local so‘zlarni bilish qulay. Ikkala variant ham tushuniladi.
scenes.say: Single or one-way. Return or round-trip.
scenes.say_uz: Single yoki one-way. Return yoki round-trip.

scenes.title: Yakuniy topshiriq: rolli suhbat
scenes.say_native: Yakuniy topshiriq. Siz Manchesterga ketmoqchisiz. Kassirdan so‘rang: borib-qaytish chiptasi, jo‘nash vaqti, perron, narxi va yo‘l qancha vaqt olishi. Sekin, lekin to‘liq gaplar bilan baland ovozda ayting. Salomlashishni va please so‘zini unutmang. Men kassir o‘rniga javob beraman.
scenes.say: You are at the ticket office. Ask for a return to Manchester. Ask the time, the platform, the price and how long it takes.
scenes.say_uz: Siz chipta kassasidasiz. Manchesterga borib-qaytish chiptasi so‘rang. Vaqtni, perronni, narxni va yo‘l qancha vaqt olishini so‘rang.

scenes.title: Namuna suhbat
board: Hello. Can I have a return to Manchester, please?
What time does the next train leave?
Which platform? How much is it? How long does it take?
scenes.say_native: Namuna mana bunday. Hello. Can I have a return to Manchester, please? What time does the next train leave? Which platform is it? How much is it? And how long does it take? Oxirida: Thank you very much. Besh ma’lumotning hammasini so‘radingizmi? Unda siz vokzalda ingliz tilida bemalol o‘zingizni tushuntira olasiz.
scenes.say: Hello. Can I have a return to Manchester, please? What time does the next train leave?
scenes.say_uz: Salom. Manchesterga borib-qaytish chiptasi olsam bo‘ladimi? Keyingi poyezd soat nechada jo‘naydi?

scenes.title: Bugungi dars xulosasi
board: by bus / by train / on foot
A single / A return to ..., please
What time...? Which platform? How long does it take?
scenes.say_native: Xulosa. Transport: bus, train, taxi, car, bike, plane. Qanday borasiz: by bus, by train, on foot, artiklsiz. Chipta: Can I have a single yoki a return to Leeds, please? Savollar: What time does it leave? Which platform? How much is it? How long does it take? Eslab qoling: does dan keyin fe’l o‘zgarmaydi. Zo‘r ish qildingiz!
scenes.say: By bus, on foot. A return, please. What time? Which platform? How long does it take?
scenes.say_uz: Avtobusda, piyoda. Borib-qaytish, iltimos. Soat nechada? Qaysi perron? Qancha vaqt oladi?

scenes.title: Uy vazifasi
board: Role-play: buy a train ticket to another city
scenes.say_native: Uy vazifasi: boshqa shaharga poyezd chiptasi sotib olish bo‘yicha rolli suhbat yozing. Kamida sakkiz gap bo‘lsin: chipta turi, shahar, vaqt, perron, narx va yo‘l qancha vaqt olishi. Uni baland ovozda ikki marta o‘qing. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni — beshala ma’lumot suhbatda bor. Keyingi darsda oddiy matnni o‘qish va tinglashni o‘rganamiz.
scenes.say: Your homework: write a ticket dialogue with eight sentences. Read it aloud twice. See you next time!
scenes.say_uz: Uy vazifangiz: sakkiz gapli chipta dialogini yozing. Uni ikki marta baland ovozda o‘qing. Keyingi darsda ko‘rishamiz!

homework_uz: Boshqa shaharga poyezd chiptasi sotib olish bo‘yicha rolli suhbat yozing: kamida 8 ta gap, unda chipta turi, vaqt, perron, narx va yo‘l vaqti bo‘lsin. Baland ovozda ikki marta o‘qing; mezon: beshala ma’lumot suhbatda bor.

quiz.why_uz: Transport vositasi “by” bilan, artiklsiz aytiladi: by bus. “With bus” o‘zbekchadan so‘zma-so‘z olingan xato.
Piyoda yurish “on foot” deyiladi. “By foot” — keng tarqalgan xato.

quiz.q: Can I ___ a return to Leeds, please?
quiz.why_uz: Muloyim so‘rov: Can I have ...? “Give me” qo‘pol eshitiladi.

quiz.q: What does “a return” mean at a station?
options: A ticket for one way only
A ticket to go and come back
A ticket for the Tube only
quiz.why_uz: Return — borib-qaytish chiptasi. Bir tomonlama chipta esa single.

quiz.q: How long ___ it take to get to the airport?
quiz.why_uz: “It” bilan savolda does ishlatiladi: How long does it take?
Vaqt haqida: It takes ... . O‘zbekchadagi “ketadi” inglizchada take, uchinchi shaxsda takes.
Does dan keyin fe’l oddiy shaklda: does leave. Fe’lga s qo‘shilmaydi.

quiz.q: In American English, a “single” ticket is a ___ ticket.
quiz.why_uz: Amerikada single o‘rniga one-way, return o‘rniga round-trip ishlatiladi.
Jo‘nash joyini “from” bilan aytamiz: It leaves from platform five.
Narx: twelve pounds fifty. Pens so‘zi odatda aytilmaydi.
